tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi smin grol las tshogs 'khyer bder bsdus pa phreng ba skor gsum gyi lo rgyus mad
༄༅/ /chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi smin grol las tshogs 'khyer bder bsdus pa phreng ba skor gsum gyi lo rgyus mad

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi smin grol las tshogs 'khyer bder bsdus pa phreng ba skor gsum gyi lo rgyus mdor bstan pa bzhugs so// chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi smin grol las tshogs dang bcas pa 'khyer bder bsdus pa phreng ba skor gsum gyi lo rgyus mdor bstan pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal mgon po phyag na pad+ma dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma dang*// mkhyen brtse'i sems dpa' rnam gnyis la// gus btud gdams par yid ches slad// lo rgyus mdor bsdus 'di skad gleng*// de yang bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir sngon gyi dus na stod thams cad g.ya' dang gangs/ bar thams cad nags tshal dang brag gi khrod du spre'u dang brag srin/ smad thams cad thang dang chu rdzing la bya dang ri dwags sna tshogs pas gang ba/ 'gro ba mi zhes bya ba'i ming yang med pa'i tshe/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams na mgon po 'od dpag med kyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la bka' bstsal pa/ bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas dngos su byin gyis ma brlabs pa'i zhing khams 'di nyid khyod kyis 'dul bar 'gyur bas/ thog mar 'gro ba mi spel| de dag bsdu dngos bzhis bsdus la smin par gyis shig /ces gsungs pa la mnyan te/ ri bo po ta la'i rtse mo rin po che'i khang bzang sprul te der gshegs nas phyag mthil g.yon pa nas 'od zer spros te spre'u byang chub sems dpa' sprul te kha ba can gyi ri brag nags khrod du bsam gtan sgom par byed/ 'phags ma sgrol mas brag srin zhig sprul te brag gseb tu gnas pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa'i thugs rjes bskul te brag srin mos spre'u byang chub sems dpa' 'dod pa spyod par sems te smras pa na spre'u byang chub sems dpas 'phags pa la zhus pas gnang ste/

brag srin mo dang spyad pas rigs drug nas 'phos pa'i bu drug byung ba/ pha spre'u des lho phyogs su nags tshal rma bya sna tshogs can zhes bya bar spre'u mang po yod pa'i zlar bskyal te re zhig na ltar phyin pas/ de rnams 'dod pa spyad pas spre'u yang min la brag srin mo yang min pa'i bu tsha mang du 'phel 'dug pa dang*/ spre'u byang chub sems dpas de rnams la nor bu dang 'bru sna lnga gnang ste/ khyod rnams kyi zas skal gyis dang ma 'ongs pa na khyod rnams kyi rigs rgyud mir gyur pa'i tshe rin po che dang 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad 'byung par 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan cing sa gzhi thams cad rin po che'i 'byung khungs su byin gyis brlabs so// de nas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i phyag g.yas pa'i mthil nas khye'u lang tsho dang ldan pa zhig sprul nas spre'u rnams kyi khrod du btang ba spre'u rnams kyis mthong nas/ de la khyod 'di ltar lang tsho dang ldan pa ci las byung dris pas/ des bdag gis mi dge ba bcu spangs dge ba bcu spyad pas 'di ltar byung ngo zhes smras pa dang*/ spre'u rnams kyis de dag bslabs te nyams su blangs pas rim gyis spre'u thams cad mi'i lus lang tsho dang ldan pa sha stag tu gyur to// de nas ring zhig lon pa'i tshe de rnams la rje dang 'bangs su btags pa med pa'i tshe/ rgya gar nas shākya ri brag pa'i rigs rgyal po skya seng gi bu chung ba rim pas dpung dang bcas pa kha ba can du bros te 'ongs pa bod du slebs pa'i tshe yar klung lha ri rol po'i rtser slebs nas bab ste 'ongs pas spre'u rnams kyis mthong bas/ gnam nas bab pa'i btsan po zhig byung ba 'di 'o cag rnams kyi rjer zhu'o zhes 'chams ste gnya' bar shing khris bteg nas bkur bas rje gnya' khri btsan por ming btags so| |de nas btsun mo blangs pa'i bu mu khri btsan po/ de nas rim bzhin ding khri btsan po/

so khri btsan po/ mer khri btsan po/ gdags khri btsan po/ srib khri btsan po dang bdun la gnam gyi khri bdun zhes zer/ de'i sras gri gum btsan po/ de nas rim bzhin spu de gung rgyal gnyis la stod kyi steng gnyis zer/ de nas/ e sho legs/ de sho legs/ thi sho legs/ gu ru legs/ 'brom shor legs/ i sho legs drug la bar gyi legs drug zer/ de nas za nam zin lde/ lde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ se snol gnam lde/ se snol po lde/ lde snol nam/ lde snol po/ lde rgyal po/ lde sprin btsan dang brgyad po la lde brgyad zer/ de nas to re long btsan/ khri btsan nam/ khri dgra dpung btsan/ khri thog rje thog btsan/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan lnga la zur gyi btsan lnga zer ro// lha tho tho ris sku mkhar yum bu gla sgang du bzhugs pa'i tshe thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od kyi sne la spang skong phyag rgya pa bab pas ngo ma shes par mtshan gnyan po gsang bar btags/ bzang po zhig yin par shes pas mchod pa phul zhing rgyal po'i pho brang du bzhugs pas dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes zhes grags/ de nas mchod pas lha tho tho ris dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu thub/ de'i sras khri gnyan gzungs btsan/ de nas rim bzhin 'brong gnyan lde ru/ stag ri gnyan gzigs/ de'i sras gnam ri srong btsan/ de'i khab tu 'bri bza' thod dkar btsun mor yod pa'i tshe/ 'phags pas bod khams 'dul ba la dbang che ba zhig dgos par dgongs te sprul pa'i khye'u g.yu'i zur phud can tshon gang pa zhig btang ba/ gnam ri srong btsan dang 'bri bza' thod dkar gnyis pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling na gzims pa'i btsun mo'i mngal du zhugs pa'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag tu med pa byung*/ de nas zla ba tshang ba'i tshe pho brang de nyid du rgyal po btsun mo yab yum la sku khams dri ba mdzad pa'i tshe rgyal bu'i mtshan la yab yum gyis srong btsan du btags/

rgyal bu nar ma son pa nas blo che bas blon chen rnams kyis 'o cag gi rgyal bu 'di ni shin tu thugs sgam mo zhes smras par srong btsan sgam por btags/ de nas rgyal po'i thugs dgongs bod khams dam pa'i chos la 'god par dgongs te 'bangs rnams kyi nang nas blo rno ba shes rab che ba thon mi a nu'i bu saṃ bho ṭa 'khor bcu drug dang bcas pa rgya gar du brdzangs te/ saṃ bho ṭas mkhas pa lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan paṇ+ḍi ta chen po lha rig pa'i seng ge las chos dang mkhas par bslabs/ sdeb sbyor/ snyan ngag /ming gi mngon brjod la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs/ bod du byon pa'i rgya gar gyi yi ge la dpe byas te bod yig brtsams te/ rgya gar gyi ka dpe lnga bcu bod yig tu sum cur bsdus/ sum cu pa sogs sgra'i bstan bcos chen po brgyad mdzad/ mdo dkon mchog sprin dang*/ za ma tog la sogs pa bsgyur/ de nas rgyal bu dgung lo bcu gsum lon pas yab yum gyis rgyal sar dbang bskur| rgyal po'i sku las 'od zer spros pa'i 'od zer re re las longs sku'i zhing re re thub pa gangs can mtsho re re/ de re re'i sku'i zhing re re dang der shākya thub pa re re dang*/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po re re sprul te 'gro don mdzad/ bod 'bangs rnams la dge ba bcu'i khrims shin tu dam par bsdams/ rta zla'i tshes brgyad kyi srod la nam mkha' nas lhas lung bstan pa ltar/ rgya gar lho phyogs siṅga la'i gling na thugs rje chen po tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i khog pa na yod pa spyan drang bar dgongs te/ rgyal po'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas 'od zer spros pa'i sna la sprul pa'i dge slong a kar ma ti zhes pa sangs rgyas a mi de was mtshan pa zhig sprul te rgya gar du brdzangs/ de nas rgya gar yul dbus a mi de wa mthong bar byas te dad par btsud/ lho phyogs siṅga lar byon nas grong khyer ke ru'i rgyal po u ma ta ke sa ra zhes sngar nang pa yin par phyis phyi par gyur pa zhig yod pa de rdzu 'phrul gyis btul nas dad pa la btsud/

des grogs byas te byon pas/ tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po sa 'og tu yod pa'i steng du glang po che shin tu che ba zhig glang po che mang pos bskor ba nyal 'dug pa'i sar rgyal po'i dmag dpung bcas 'byor bas glang chen gzhan rnams bros/ che shos de 'khun pa 'debs lag pas sa gtor zhing khros te song*/ rgyal pos ji ltar yin sprul pa'i dge slong la dris pas/ dge slong na re glang po che shin tu che ba des ni bros/ che shos des 'khun pa 'debs/ lag pas sa gtor zhing khros te song*/ nged glang po che rnams tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i rtsar 'dug pas tsan+dan gyi nus pas glang po che 'di rnams la chu dang*/ sa dang*/ me dang*/ thog dang*/ yams dang*/ g.yo ba dang*/ mi'i 'jigs pa ste 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa yin pas gnas de phrogs pas khyod rnams kyi bstan pa la bdag gis skye ba phyi ma gnod pa byed par gyur cig ces smon lam btab par 'dug /de phyis rgyal po glang dar ma bya ba 'byung gsungs| de ji tsam nas 'byung zhus pas/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po nas gdung rabs bdun nam bcu nas 'byung ngo zhes kyang gsungs/ de nas glang po che nang gi che shos nyal ba'i shul gyi bye ma brkos pa'i 'og nas tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i sdong po thon pa rked pa bcad pas 'od dang dal bus chod cig ces sgra byung ba ltar bcad pas de'i nang nas thugs rje chen po rang byung bcu gcig zhal byon nas mthong ma thag der yod pa kun thar par bkod/ de nyid dge slong gis spyan drangs/ yang dge slong rgyal po dang bcas pa po ta lar byon pas/ tshes bco lnga'i nub shug pa'i phung po zhig la zla zer phog ma thag me tog dmar phung gis byung bas/ de tsan+dan gor shir+ṣa yin pas de'i sdong po la mchod sdong zhig dkrugs pa dang shing tshal pa dang bcas pa dge slong gis bsnams/ der dge slong gis yul de'i rgyal khams chos la btsud/

slar rgya mtsho'i 'gram bye ma'i gling du byon pas 'jag ma re re'i steng na lha mo re re 'dug pa mthong bas ngo mtshar te de'i 'jag ma phon gcig /mchod rten pad+ma'i 'khor lo'i nang nas sangs rgyas 'od srung dang*/ 'khor ba 'jig /shākya thub pa gsum gyi gdung ring bsrel bzhugs pa nas snyim pa re re bsnams/ slar ma ga dhar byon te byang chub kyi shing gi rtsa ba la mchod sdong bskrun te de'i nang du sngar gyi gdung ring bsrel khyor ba gsum po bcug cing*/ de'i rtse mo'i cha la me tog btags pa gcig dang bcas pa bsnams/ yang gnas chen po brgyad du byon pas thams cad kyi bye ma re re'i steng na/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'bum 'bum bzhugs pa gzigs pas de nas bye ma bre gang yang bsnams nas bod du byon pas brag stod tshal du/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar phul bas rgyal po mnyes shing rgyal pos de rnams 'bral spang du mdzad/ rgyal pos tsan+dan gyi sku la mchod cing sku la gsol ba btab pas tsan+dan gyi skus/ rgyal po chen po de ltar na nga'i sku gcig bzhengs shig /ces gsung byon pa ltar rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la byang chub kyi shing la srog shing*/ gor shir+ṣas ru shing*/ rgya mtsho'i 'jag mas rtsib ma/ gnas chen brgyad kyi sas sku sha/ nai rañjā na'i bye ma dang*/ tsan+dan brdar ba'i phye ma/ ba dkar mo'i 'o mas sbrus pa'i 'jim pa/ nang gzhug tsan+dan gyi sku dang mchod sdong gsum gyis bya'o dgongs te de rnams sku mdun du spungs te mtshan mo de 'das pa dang*/ rgyu de rnams la thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal rang byon du phebs pa phyis nang gzigs pas ya mtshan che yang*/ tsan+dan gyi sku ma bzhugs so dgongs ma thag tu sku des dar gyi sham thabs brdzes| zhabs g.yas pa bskums pa nas 'od byung ba tsan+dan gyi sku zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil nas drangs te thugs kar bsdus nas thugs ka nas tsan+dan gyi sku gzugs thon par mdzad do// de nas rgyal pos khab bzhes par dgongs te rang byon gyi thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab pas sku'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gnyis spros pa gcig bal yul dang*/

gcig rgya nag tu song bas de gnyis la gzigs pas bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i sras mo khri btsun mo lo bcu drug lon pa lha mo khro gnyer ma'i sprul par 'dug /rgya nag tu rgyal po thang tha'i dzung gi sras mo kong jo lo bcu drug lon pa sgrol ma'i sprul par 'dug pa gzigs te/ phyis nang blon po mgar dang thon mi la de gnyis 'dug par gsungs pas/ blon po gnyis kyis de gnyis rgyal po'i btsun mor spyan drangs par gsol/ blon po 'dun gros la 'chams/ blon po mgar gyis gtsos pa'i rta pa brgyas gser gyi khrab la sogs pa nor mang po khyer te bal yul du phyin/ rgyal po srong btsan gyis bka' shog gi sgrom bu yang bskur/ bal po'i rgyal por phul bas sras mo'i rdzongs su lha mi bskyod rdo rje/ thugs rje chen po rang byon/ byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ tsan+dan gyi sgrol ma rang byung*/ nor dang rin chen glang po che'i rgyab khal bdun dang bcas pa brdzangs te rgyal po srong btsan la phul/ de nas bal bzas rgyal po 'di sgo phyir mi 'byon pa 'di gzhan gyi dpung la 'jigs pa yin pas de med par bya'o snyam te/ pho brang dmar po'i rir rgyal mkhar lcags ri dang bcas pa srin yul laṅka pu ri dang mtshungs pa zhig brtsigs/ de'i lho phyogs kyi thad na yar pho brang dgu thog byas pa dang*/ pho brang dmar po gnyis dngul gyi sprin zam gyis sbrel ba sogs bkod pa tshad las 'das par bzos/ slar yang rgya nag nas kong jo spyan drangs par blon po mgar rta pa sum brgya dang bcas pa baiḍūr+ya'i rmog la sogs pa nor mang po dang rgyal po'i bka' shog gi sgrom bu dang bcas pa khyer te brdzangs| rgya nag nas lha gcig kong jo spyan 'dren pa la mtha'i rgyal po rnams kyi blon po mang po dang rig pa 'gran pas rgyal bar byas/ kong jo'i rdzongs su lha shākya mu ni dang*/ rin po che'i bang mdzod mang po dang*/

gtsug lag gi skor 'go sum brgya bcu la sogs pa dang bcas bod du byon/ blon po mgar rjes rgya nag tu bsdad na'ang rig pa du mas myur du kong jo'i rjes non te lhan cig tu bod rgyal po'i drung du byon to// de nas kong jos sa rtsis byas te yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i sa ngos bzung*/ skyon lnga bzlog pa'i thabs byas/ sa'i dgra rnams mnan cing*/ 'o thang mtsho srin mo'i snying khrag gi steng du ras sa bskyal/ rgyal pos 'phrul blon gyi snang ba byas te bal bza'i lha khang bzhengs/ ra mo che klu'i pho brang gi steng du kong jo'i lha khang bzhengs/ de dag gi sngon du ru gnon bzhi/ mtha' 'dul bzhi/ yang 'dul bzhi rnams nyi ma re re la grub par byas so// de nas rgyal pos bod du dam chos bsgyur bar dgongs te/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra/ bram ze shaṃ ka ra dang*/ bal po'i slob dpon shī la mañju dang*/ kha che'i slob dpon dā na dang*/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po li byin dang*/ rgya nag gi slob dpon hwa shang ma hā rnams spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba thon mi saṃ bho ṭa dang*/ de'i mchan bu lo tsā dharma ko ṣa dang*/ lha lung rdo rje dpal rnams kyis byas te 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa mdo rgyud mang du bsgyur/ gzhan yang 'jig rten lugs kyi bon/ sgrung rgyud dang*/ le'u la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang bod 'bangs kyi blo bsgyur te bzod chos la bkod/ phyi rabs kyi don du 'phrul snang gi lha khang du theg pa che chung gi chos dang*/ mthu dang*/ stobs dang*/ nor dang*/ bka' chems yi ge mang po ka ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'og dang*/ klu khang la sogs par gter du sbas/ de ltar rang re kha ba can rnams kyi don du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar gyi rnam rol du bstan pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes grags pa de nyid kyis/

theg pa chen po rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rnam grangs ni 'di lta ste/ sgrub thabs chen po'i skor la/ drug skor/ sum skor gnyis/ de gnyis spyi'i khog 'bubs/ sgos kyi bshad 'grel/ ṭī ka dang bsdus don rnams ni bshad chos so// sgrub thabs drug skor rtsa ba/ de'i las tshogs dang bcas pa/ sum skor rtsa ba/ gcig skor rnams ni lag len sgrub pa'i chos so// sgrub thabs phran bu la/ sgrub thabs bsdus pa dang*/ 'bring po/ rgyas pa thugs rje chen po gcig sgrub dang gsum ni lag len gyi chos skor ro// rgyas pa sum dril dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gnyis sku gsung thugs kyi sgrub pa yin no// rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud ni/ khro bos bgegs dbang du bsdus pa yin/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang skor dang*/ gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro dang*/ yi dam lha dbang du bsdus pa gsum ni dbang sdud kyi chos gsum yin no| |byin rlabs sba chos ni nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi bar byed pa byin rlabs nus pa'i chos yin no// de rnams lag len gyi chos sgrub skor drug gi las phran yin no// zhal gdams gyi skor la| rgya che ba gzhan don du gdams pa dang*/ zab pa rang don du gdams pa gnyis su 'byed pa las/ rgya che ba gzhan don du gdams pa'i skor la/ thugs rje chen po dngos la rgyal pos zhus pa/ rgyal po la yab kyis zhus pa/ yum gyis zhus pa/ bal bza' khri btsun gyis zhus pa/ rgya bza' kong jos zhus pa/ sras gung srong gung btsan gyis zhus pa/ sras mo khrom pa rgyan gyis zhus pa/ phyi blon nang blon gyis zhus pa ste brgyad po ni zhus lan gyi skor ro// yab la ngo sprod du gdams pa/ yum la ngo sprod/ bal bza' la ngo sprod/ rgya bza' la ngo sprod/ sras mo la ngo sprod/ nang blon la ngo sprod/ phyi blon la ngo sprod du gdams pa brgyad ni ngo sprod kyi skor ro// yab yum la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs su gdams pa/

rgyal srid chos kyis zung zhig par bstan pa/ lha gcig khrom pa rgyan la zhal gdams/ bal bza' la thugs dam bka' rgya/ rgya bza' la gsang gtam gal che/ nang blon la gdams pa/ phyi blon la gdams pa/ blon 'bangs la gdams pa/ bod 'bangs spyi la gdams pa/ nang 'khor gyi bud med rnams la gdams pa/ phyi 'khor gyi bud med rnams la gdams pa/ bud med spyi la gdams pa dang*/ bcu gnyis po de zhal gdams bka' nan gyi skor ro// yi ge drug pa la/ drug drug sum cu rtsa drug /yi ge drug pa'i yon tan gyi bzla thabs drug /lha lnga'i bstod pa/ gtso 'khor don bstod/ yi ge drug pa'i dgu phrugs bstod pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi bstod pa/ bkra shis smon lam brgyad po de yi ge drug pa'i gsung gi zhal gdams kyi skor ro// nyi nub lam 'khyer/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed lam 'khyer/ rang don khyad par du 'phags pa'i lam 'khyer drug /snang ba rin po che'i tshogs lam du 'khyer ba/ gtor ma lam 'khyer dang lnga po ni lam 'khyer zhal gdams kyi skor ro// de rnams ni bka' chos dang po'i shog dril gcig yin no// zhal gdams skor la/ drug tshan bcu pa/ sum tshan bzhi bcu pa| dpe don bzhi tshan bcu dgu pa/ drug tshan nyi shu rtsa drug /bcu tshan nyi shu rtsa gsum pa dang lnga po de ni zhal gdams thor bu'i skor ro// dbang po tha ma'i lam rim gsum skor/ dbang po 'bring gi lam rim gsum skor/ dbang po rab kyi lam rim gsum skor te de gsum ni lam rim gsum skor gyi zhal gdams so// 'khor ba 'jug ldog dang*/ lta dgongs don rgyud gnyis/ mas 'jug yas ldog gi zhal gdams gnyis so// de rnams ni bka' chos bar ma'i shog dril gcig go// zhal gdams skor gcig la/ skye bo ma rig pa chos la 'dzud pa dang*/ chos pa chos dang mi ldan pa chos la 'dzud pa dang*/ sngags pa sngags dang mi ldan pa sngags la 'dzud pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rnal 'byor dang mi ldan pa rnal 'byor la 'dzud pa dang*|

chos pa mtshang nas bskul ba dang*/ skye bo tha mal pa rnams mtshang nas bskul ba dang drug po de ni mtshang gi chos drug gi zhal gdams so// sgrub pa sgrub 'jug /drug tshan sum cu rtsa drug /skyon can skyon med nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ nges shes nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dran pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste lnga po de ni gang zag chos pa srang du gzhug pa'i zhal gdams so// pha rol tu phyin pa bcu/ bslab pa'i mtha' drug /bsgrub pa'i mtha' drug /bshad thabs drug ste bzhi po de ni nang gi chos bzhi'i zhal gdams so// mtshan gyi zhal gdams/ rigs drug sku drug rang grol du bstan pa/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos gsum/ yang gsang khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos gsum ste/ bzhi po de ni thugs rje chen po'i zhal gdams so// bar do drug gi gdams pa dang*/ 'pho ba bzhi yi gdams pa gnyis ni 'chi ba'i rim pa la bslab pa dang*/ 'chi kha ma la dgos pa'i zhal gdams so// chos kyi gdams pa/ thun mong gi zhal gdams sum cu rtsa drug pa/ ngo sprod khyad par can thun mong ma yin pa/ khyad par drug nas gdams pa gsum gsum/ thun mong khyad par gyi bslab bya'i zhal gdams so// dam tshig gi gdams pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro'i gdams pa/ sdom pa'i gdams pa/ dbang dang byin rlabs kyi gdams pa dang bzhi po ni phyi nang gi bslab bya bzhi'i zhal gdams so// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsngo ba bsdus pa dang bcas pa/ gson gshin gyi bsngo ba yon bshad dang bcas pa/ bsnyen gnas srung mtshams dang bcas pa/ sems bskyed rgyas pa cho ga dang bcas pa/ dam tshig blang thabs sgrub lung dang bcas pa/ bsnyen sgrub kyi khog pa chen mo/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rim drug tu bskur ba/ tshig dbang rin po che bzhi dang bcas pa ste/ cho ga'i rim pa brgyad po de gzhan la phan gdags shing rang smin pa'i zhal gdams so// chos skor de rnams ni bka' chos tha ma'i shog dril gcig go// de ltar shog dril gsum po de ni zhal gdams che tsho'i skor zhes grags so// zhal gdams zab don chung tsho'i skor la/

yab kyis zhus pa la zab par gdams pa/ de bzhin du yum gyis zhus pa/ jo mo bal bza' khri btsun gyis zhus pa/ jo mo rgya mo kong jos zhus pa/ jo mo zhang zhung bza' li thig sman gyis zhus pa/ jo mo ru yong bza' rgyal mo btsun gyis zhus pa/ jo mo tshe yong bza' khri lcam gyis zhus pa/ sras gung srong btsan gyis zhus pa/ sras mo khrom pa rgyan lha gcig ma la gdams pa rnams ni nang gi 'khor dgu la gdams pa'i zab don rnams so// phyi'i 'khor la gdams pa la/ thon mi saṃ bho ṭas zhus par chos thams cad thugs rje chen po'i gdams pa tshig gcig la 'dus par bstan pa/ lha lung rdo rje dpal la chos thams cad tshig don gnyis su med par thugs rje chen po'i gdams par 'dus pa/ lo tsā ba tsār+ya ā lo ke la chos thams cad don gnyis su med pa thugs rje chen po'i dgongs pa la 'dus par bstan pa/ nang blon sna chen po la rgan po 'chi kha ma'i skye ba rtsad gcod ma'i gdams pa/ phyi blon khyung po dpung btang bzung rtse la byang chub kyi gnas su blo bde ba'i gdams pa/ sdig pa'i dka' las byed pa sbas 'brong pa shor mdo btsan la sdig pa phyags mas 'debs pa ngan song skye sgo gcod pa sku gsum sangs rgyas thob pa'i gdams pa/ blon chen mgar stong btsan yul srung la sdig pa stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags par bstan pa/ bka'i phyag 'tshang ba 'bri bse ru gung ston la thugs rje chen pos dngos su zhal bstan pa rnams ni bka' la btags pa'i 'khor brgyad la zab don du gsungs pa'i skor ro/ /gzhan yang thun mong gi zhal gdams lnga la/ lta ba gsum pa/ don gsum pa/ pha rol phyin drug /tshad med bzhi/ sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad rnams so| |nyams su blang bya bdun ni/ bla ma sgrub pa/ lha lam du blang ba/ sdom pa yar ldan pa/ rtsa rlung gi gdams pa/ mtshan bcas/ mtshan med/ zung 'jug /bdag med zung 'jug rnams so// thugs rgyud drug la/

pha rol tu phyin pa'i thugs rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po'i thugs rgyud/ rdzogs pa chen po'i thugs rgyud/ dbu ma chen po'i thugs rgyud/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs rgyud/ chos spyi dang mi 'gal ba thugs rje chen po'i thugs rgyud rnams so// thugs rje chen po'i gnad kyi khyad par zab don gyi gdams pa drug ni/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum bsgom pa'i ngo sprod/ zung 'jug gsum gyi gdams pa/ dbang po rab la bar do med pa'i lam 'khyer/ dbang po 'bring la bar dor 'tshang rgya ba'i lam 'khyer/ dbang po tha ma la 'da' kha 'chi brod kyi gdams pa/ mtshan thos pas 'tshang rgya ba/ snying po bzlas pas 'tshang rgya ba/ yi ge btags pas 'tshang rgya ba rnams so// zab pa rang don gyi gdams pa ni/ thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs ngo sprod/ brtul zhugs kyi gdams pa/ phyi gnod byed pho mo zhi ba dang*/ nang nad zhi ba/ gsang ba dug lnga zhi ba/ 'gro drug rang shar rang grol rnams so// zab don rang don lta dgongs kyi skor la/ zhal gdams nyi shu rtsa bdun yod pa ni/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi zhal gdams/ rgyal po'i chos bdun/ rtsa ba'i chos brgyad| la bzla ba bdun/ 'dra ba bzhi/ dgongs pa bzhi/ bzhi tshan gsum pa/ don skor bzhi tshan gnyis pa/ mthar thug bzhi/ lam bzhi/ yin pa bzhi/ don skor gsum/ rgyud la bsam pa bzhi/ gsum tshan gsum pa/ bzhi tshan gsum pa/ lnga tshan gsum pa/ drug tshan gsum pa/ rtogs pa'i gdeng bcu/ rang grol bcu/ gzhi gnas lugs kyi chos bzhi tshan gnyis pa/ chos nyid rang sa ba/ sgo bzhi/ mchog bzhi/ sna tshogs rang snang*/ sna tshogs rang gsal/ sna tshogs rang dag /sna tshogs rang zhi/ sna tshogs rang grol rnams so| |de ltar chos skyong ba sprul pa'i rgyal po'i zhal gdams che tsho dang*/ chung tsho zhes pa'i skor bye brag tu bgrang na chos kyi rnam grangs brgya dang lnga bcu yod pa rnams/ gdul bya rigs can gsum la so so'i blo dang 'tsham par legs par gsungs nas bka' stsal pa'i chos de dag thams cad gcig la gcig dgos pa min gyi/

so so rang nyid gang 'dod nyams su blang ba'i chos yin la/ mdo sde lta ba sgom med kyi lugs kyi thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong chung ngu las tshogs dang bcas pa ni/ sprul ba'i rgyal po'i thugs dam yin pas thun mong gzhan gyi dbang skal du ma gyur pa las dang skal par ldan pa zhig dang 'phrad par 'gyur bas logs su sbas nas rgyas btab bo// sgrub thabs drug skor/ sum skor/ gcig skor gsum gzhung yin pas gcig la gcig dgos pa ma yin/ gzhan la phan thogs pa'i chos yin pas thams cad la shod cig ston cig sgrubs shig sgrub thabs kyi las phran rnams kyang sgom pa dang sgrub pa'i chos yin pas sgom rim rnams sgoms/ sgrub rim rnams sgrubs/ zhal gdams rnams gzhan don skor tsho gang la gang phan dang*/ lag len ltos la drang nges ston pa'i snod ltos la shod cig /chos la tshud cig rang don gyi zhal gdams rnams thad kar rang la gang dgos dang gang phan nyams su longs/ lta dgongs kyi chos rnams rtogs pa'i gdeng gis zin par gyis la nyams su longs/ chos nyid kyi don gzhi la ma bzhag cig /rtogs pa brtan par gyis shig /nyams len med par kha ta dang*/ yid smon dang*/ byed blo dang*/ chos kyi rang bzhin nang nas ma grol bar khas bshad pas sangs mi rgya/ thugs rje chen po'i chos kha 'byams su ma shor ba/ nga'i gdams pa 'di rnams mdo hril gyis dril na chos ji tsam bshad kyang*/ byams pa dang snying rjes gzhi bzung nas sems can blos ma bzung na thugs rje chen po'i chos ma yin no// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs nas rang nyid gcig pu thar bar 'dod/ bde ba 'dod/ grol bar 'dod na thugs rje chen po'i chos ma yin no// sems can thams cad kyi don du sems bskyed par ma nus na byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi chos ma yin no// sems can thams cad kyi don du ma bsgrubs na byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mi 'grub pas/

'di nyid bsgrub bar 'dod na byams pa dang snying rjes gzhi zung*/ sgrub pa la brtson 'grus bskyed/ snying po yi ge drug pa zlos pa 'di yid bzhin nor bu rin po che'i snying po yin pas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'di las 'byung ba yin pas nan tan bskyed cig /nges don gyi chos ji ltar tsam bshad kyang chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po chos kyi sku ni rang sems nyid la yod pas ngo shes par gyis/ goms par gyis/ 'dris par gyis/ brtan par gyis shig /thugs rje chen po rang las gzhan zhig /gnas gzhan na bzhugs pa bsgrub par 'dod/ zhal mthong bar 'dod/ dngos grub thob par 'dod na/ thun mong gi dngos grub ster ba las/ mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas las ring du 'gyur ro// thugs rje chen po'i chos skor 'di rnams ma 'ongs skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad pa'i tshe thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa dar bar gyis/ skal ldan snod dang ldan pa zhig gis bstan pa rgyas par spel bar 'gyur ro// zhes sogs zhal gdams bslab bya mang du gsungs/ lo tsā ba chen po thon mi saṃ bho ṭa la yang bka' bstsal pa/ ngas bshad pa'i chos 'di rnams dpe gnyis su bris te/ gcig ni chu dar sngon po la rin chen gser gyis bris pa bse'i sgrom bur chug rgya rim pa bdun gyis thob la/ khra 'brug rgyal po'i lha khang gi dkor mdzod rgyal po'i bla gter du sbos/ dus kyi tha ma la bstan pa nub tu nye bar thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' zhig gis dkor mdzod nas rnyed de bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur ro// gcig ni rgya shog la shog dril bris la thugs rje chen po'i zhing khams su lha sa byang chub gling 'di'i rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og tu sbos shig /de ni nyi ma lho phyogs nas sngags kyi grub pa thob pa zhig gis rnyed nas gdul bya'i chos su 'gyur/

dpe de dang las 'brel yod pa/ skye ba mang po las 'bras sbyangs pa/ sgrub pa la brtson pa/ byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa zhig las dang skal pa ldan par 'byung gi de la shog dril rnams gtod cig /des nyi ma lho phyogs nas dbus dang*/ nub dang*/ byang du rgyas par 'gyur ro// dus de tsa na gsung yi ge drug pa rang byung du 'char ba 'ong*/ thugs rang byung du 'char ba 'ong*/ thugs rje chen po'i sku rang byung du 'char ba 'ong*/ byang chub sems dpa' sa la gnas pa'ang 'ga' zhig 'byung*/ thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa cung zad cig 'byung ngo*// de'i dus su byin gyis brlabs pa thugs rje chen po che bas sgrubs shig /thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa la bkod la chos shod/ byang chub kyi sems sbyongs/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems skyongs shig /lar dus de tsa na shākya thub pa'i bstan pa mar 'grib dus song bas gzhung gi chos la nyan bshad mi byed par man ngag gi brul chos la rtsis su byed/ chos la gsar 'grogs che bas dar rkyen/ sgrub pa nyams su len mi nus pas nub rkyen/ chos kyi kha 'dzin che bas sgro dang skur 'debs/ ston chen rnams kyi snying la bdud zhugs pas gcig gis gcig la smod/ gcig gis gcig la rtsod/ sngags pa rnams kyi snying ma dam sri zhugs pas gcig gis gcig la mthu rgyag byed/ skyes pa rnams kyi snying la 'gong po zhugs pas dme 'khrug byed/ bud med rnams kyi snying la 'dre mo zhugs pas bza' 'thab byed cing rang srog gcod/ byis pa rnams kyi snying la the'u rang zhugs pas spyod log sna tshogs byed/ lha klu gnyan po 'khrug pas char chu dus su mi 'bab pa 'ong*/ skabs skabs su mu ge 'ong*/ mi rnams bsod nams mar 'grib pa'i dus shig 'ong*/ dus ngan de tsa na bde skyid 'dzoms par 'dod na spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba thob/ snying po yi ge drug pa sgrongs/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang dgos 'dod thams cad 'di las 'byung bas rin po che dgos 'dod kun 'byung la gsol ba thob/

phyi ma sgrib pa byang nas byang chub thob par gdon mi za'o/ /'di la the tshom dang yid gnyis ma byed par/ thugs rje chen po'i sgoms shig /sgrubs shig /ston cig /shod cig /dar zhing rgyas par gyis shig /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa btsugs pa yin no// chos kyi gzhung btsugs pa yin no// dge 'dun gyi che ba btsugs pa yin no// skal ldan zhig dang 'phrad nas/ thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa tshugs shig /nga nas rgyal rabs lnga 'das pa na 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa khri srong lde'u btsan zhes bya ba chos skyong pa'i rgyal po 'byung zhing dam pa'i chos dar bar byed mthar rang nyid mngon par rdzogs par 'grub par 'gyur/ de nas rgyal rabs gnyis na lag na rdo rje'i sprul pa mnga' bdag khri ral ba can bya ba 'byung*/ dam pa'i chos shin tu rgyas par byed/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga nas bstan pa'i me ro langs nas dam pa'i chos shin tu rgyas par 'gyur ro// lnga brgya'i tha ma la nga'i bstan pa rgyas shing dad pa can dang byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro// zhes sprul pa'i rgyal pos zhal chems su ji ltar bzhag pa ltar/ lo tsā ba thon mi saṃ bho ṭa dang*/ lha lung rdo rje dpal gyis lo rgyus kyi shog dril zhal gdams dang bcas pa gcig /sgrub thabs kyi zhal gdams shog dril gcig /sgrub thabs kyi bshad 'bum shog dril gcig |zhal gdams kyi shog dril gcig ste chos skor gyi shog dril bzhi/ mi chos kyi zhal gdams shog dril gcig ste/ shog dril chen po lnga bris shing sgrom bur bcug nas las dang skal pa ldan pa'i skyes bu dang de 'phrad par shog /phrad nas thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /ces sogs smon lam btab nas thugs rje chen po'i lha khang gi rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og tu sbas/ las phran 'ga' zhig ni lha khang gi gdung kheb dang gnod sbyin nā ga ku be ra'i brla g.yas pa rnams su sbas te rgyas btab bo// de ltar sprul pa'i rgyal pos bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/

sgos 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad nas/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa shing pho stag gi lo'i dpyid ra ba'i yar tshes bzhi'i nyin glo 'bur byang gi 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sku mdun du/ rgyal po dbus/ khri btsun g.yas/ kong jo g.yon/ mong bza' rgyab tu bzhugs nas/ nga'i jo mo rnams dang*/ blon 'bangs rnams dang*/ bod 'bangs thams cad 'dir 'dus shig gsungs nas/ blon po sna chen po mgo bo nang rkang pa phyir bzhag lag gnyis sgo'i ru gnyis la 'chang nas bsdad pa'i tshe/ rgyal po zhal phyir log nas nga'i bod 'bangs rnams sang nangs par rgyal po'i zhal mthong ngo zer na nga'i yi dam thugs rje chen po dang*/ jo bo shākya gnyis la phyag dang mchod pa gyis shig /phyi ma 'tshang rgya'o bod 'bangs rnams zhes sogs gsungs/ khri btsun kong jo gnyis kyis kyang de ltar gsungs/ gzhan yang bslab bya zhal gdams mang du gsungs nas rgyal po nyid thugs rje chen po'i sku'i thugs ka na spyan ce re gzigs nas 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas thugs rje chen po'i sku'i thugs kar thim| de nas thugs rje chen po'i spyan g.yas pa nas 'od byung ba lha gcig khri btsun la phog pas 'od du zhu nas lha mo khro gnyer ma'i thugs kar thim/ yang thugs rje chen po'i spyan g.yon pa nas 'od byung ba lha gcig kong jo la phog pas 'od du zhu nas lha mo sgrol ma la thim/ yang rnam 'gyur la lar ni lha gcig gnyis kyang thugs rje chen po nyid la thim par gsungs/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin thugs rje chen po'i sku'i thugs ka nas rgyal po'i sku stod phyung nas/ bod 'bangs rnams la ma 'ongs pa'i tshe chos kyi bstan pa dar nub sogs lung bstan dang bslab bya mang du gsungs nas de nyid du nub/ yang blon po sna chen pos smre sngags kyis gsol ba btab pas thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas rgyal po yab yum gsum dbu nyug mdzad par/

jo mo mang bza' khri lcam dang*/ blon po sna chen po gnyis kas phyag byas gsol ba btab bzhugs par zhus pas ma gnang ba dang*/ slar blon po chen po sna chen pos rgyal po la gdams pa'i bslab bya mang du zhus pa rnams legs par gsungs te yang sku de nyid la nub par gyur to// de rnams kyi tshe las dag pa dang ma dag pa mtha' dag gi snang ngor ya mtshan gyis ltas dpag tu med pa byung*| de nas blon po mgar chen pos blon po gzhan rnams la/ kyai/ gson cig mtha' bzhi'i rgyal po rnams dang yul khams gzhan gyi mi rnams kyis/ bod kyi blon po rnams gdug pa che bas rgyal po yab yum gsum khungs med gtang ngo zer ba'i grags pa ngan pa phog tu 'byung bas/ da ni rgyal po'i pur sbyang ba'i tshul tsam byas na mi btub bam zer ba ltar thams cad gros mthun te/ rgyal po 'od zer dam pa'i pho brang nas phyal snyung ba la zas log shor nas bsnyungs/ de'i g.yog khri btsun gyis mdzad pas khri btsun yang gtsang khang gi gtsug lag khang na bsnyungs/ de'i g.yog kong jos mdzad pas kong jo yang bum thang gi gtsug lag khang du bsnyungs so// rgyal po yab yum gsum ka sku khams mi bde'o gyis shig |de tsug ma byas na phyis bang so brtsig rgyu mi thub bo zer ba ltar byas/ shog 'dam gyis rgyal po yab yum gsum gyi sku 'bag bcos/ sman bzang po bskus/ rgyal po yab yum gsum gyi na bza' rnams bsgron nas ci 'dra ba byas/ de nas blon po mgar gyis bod 'bangs rnams la mdang sum rgyal po yab yum gsum sku gshegs nas med do// bod 'bangs rnams kyi cha rkyen dang shing khyer la shog cig /rgyal po yab yum gsum gyi pur sbyang dgos bang so brtsig dgos so zhes dril bsgrags par/ klung du bang so brtsigs/ rgyal po'i sku 'bag stag gzig gi lpags pa'i steng du rin po che'i khri la bzhugs/ shing rtas spyan drangs bang so'i nang du bzhugs pur khang la zhugs phul/

pur khang la sbyang ba'i tshul byas pas blon po sogs thams cad la dag pa'i snang ba mtha' yas pa byung*/ jo mo gnyis kyi sku 'bag kyang de ltar pur sbyang ba'i tshul byas so// de nas gdung rabs lnga 'das nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas phebs te/ slob dpon gyis mnga' bdag la nyid kyi mes po srong btsan sgam pos ra sa'i dbu rtse byang ngos kyi rta mgrin zhabs 'og dang*/ gdung khebs dang gnod sbyin nā ga ku be ra'i brla g.yas pa rnams nas thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs rtsa rgyud pa gsum/ las phran brgyad/ zhal gdams brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa lnga sbas nas yod pa mnga' bdag la 'don par gsungs nas mchod yon gnyis ka nam mkha' nas byon te lha sar phebs/ gter rnams phyung ste mnga' bdag la bstan pas mnga' bdag shin tu mnyes/ gter gyi nang nas thugs rje chen po stong rtsa'i sgrub thabs gab pa mngon phyung gi zhal gdams/ thugs rje chen po sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i bskyed rdzogs/ thugs dam mthong ba'i phan yon/ srong btsan 'da' kha'i zhal chems rnams la mnga' bdag gis thugs dam du mdzad/ de'i rjes su grub thob dngos grub kyis thugs rje chen po'i chos skal de rnams rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og nas spyan drangs te/ la stod pa mi bskyod rdo rje la gnang*/ des mi bskyod rje btsun shākya bzang po la gnang*/ ra sa'i chu rags dang zhig gso mdzad pa'i lung bstan thob nas gnod sbyin khang pa'i nā ga ku be ra'i brla g.yon pa nas gab pa mngon phyung gi skor rnams dang*/ mdo skor rnams bton nas sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum thams cad yongs su tshang bar mdzad nas lha rje dge ba 'bum la gnang*/ des lcam ye shes mchog la/ des grub thob chu sgom pa la/ des mtha' bzhi bya bral ba la/ des 'jam dbyangs bsod nams seng ge/

des bla ma bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ des ra sa'i chu rags pa dbus pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ des dbu dum pa 'dul ba pa/ des byang sems dpal ldan gzhon nu/ des rje btsun dkon mchog skyabs/ des sprul sku pad+ma dbang rgyal/ des mnga' ris glo bo pa rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje/ des rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs| chos rgyal phun tshogs/ des yongs kyi bshes gnyen dam pa rin chen dpal/ des bla ma rin chen dang mkhan chen rnam 'joms phun tshogs gnyis char la gnang ba yin la/ bdag gis ni rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi lung yongs su rdzogs pa drin can sangs rgyas rin po che'i drung dang*/ dbang skor gyi cho ga ni rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen rnam 'joms phun tshogs kyi zhabs drung du mnos pa yin no// yang na ra sa'i chu rags pa dbus pa blo gros rgyal mtshan yan 'dra ba la/ des 'phags mchog nor bu bzang po/ des chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ des mkhas grub dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ des bla ma dkon mchog skyabs/ des rje mkhyen rab dbang phyug /des mnga' ris rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje/ des rgyal dbang rat+na'i zhabs sogs gong ltar yin no// de ltar sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud rnam par dag pa dpyad gzhi dang the tshom sgro skur gyi gnas dang bral ba nyi shu rtsa gcig gi nang don mdo 'gag rnams bsdus te/ nyid kyi yab yum jo mo sras pho mo phyi nang gi blon po 'khor 'bangs rnams la gdams pa'i zab chos rnams lhan cig tu bzhugs pa la rgyal po bka' 'bum zhes grags pa gangs can pa rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i bgo skal pha 'bab tu gyur pa de nyid kyi smin grol rnams 'khyer bder bsdus te/ phreng ba skor gsum gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus pa bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang bcas pa 'di'ang*/ dad ldan yid ches 'phel ba'i phyir rgyal po bka' 'bum nyid sor bzhag tshig don bsdus nas bkod pa ma gtogs/

bod kyi bla ma mang rabs kyi chos 'byung rnams la rang 'dod kyis gung bsgrigs/ 'thad legs zol zog gya tshom la rgyab bcas pa'i 'khrul pa nying 'khrul sum 'khrul zad med mtha' med pa rnams nas kha 'gengs spu tsam ma byas pa/ dbur stod 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung las shākya'i dge slong rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes ming gzhan dbur smyon du grub dbang pad+mas btags pa bdag gis/ rang lo drug cu re gcig pa shing lug gro bzhin zla ba'i phyogs phyi ma'i dga' ba dang por/ 'bri gung rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu legs par sbyar ba dag go// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
